services.name: Day Of Class
services.desc: New to Gemini? Come experience a gymnastics class and see what makes our programs so special! Our trial classes give your child the opportunity to explore the gym, meet our coaches, learn new skills, and experience gymnastics in a fun and welcoming environment. Once we receive your request, our team will contact you to confirm the trial class time and complete the booking process. Please allow 2-5 business days for us to respond to your request. Your trial class is not confirmed until payment received and you receive a confirmation from our team.Trial classes are not offered during the first or last week of our session.
